items.q: What if my kids don't have their own phone?
items.a: No problem! NidoQuest is designed to be used directly from the parents' phone or tablet. With 1 single tap you can switch between Guide Mode (parents) and Explorer Mode (kids) so they can check off their own missions.

items.q: How does the 7-day free trial work?
items.a: You get 7 full days with access to all features: unlimited explorers, missions, daily wheel, notifications, and reward redemptions. No contracts and you can cancel anytime.

items.q: What ages is NidoQuest suitable for?
items.a: NidoQuest includes tailored guidelines from age 5 to 16+: Little Ones (5-8), Juniors (9-13), and Teens (14+), with difficulty levels and star amounts matched to their maturity.

items.q: How does it help reduce screen time?
items.a: Instead of abruptly banning screens and provoking conflict, NidoQuest turns screen time into a healthy reward that kids earn beforehand through positive habits (reading, tidying, homework).
We process payments via Wompi's secure gateway (Bancolombia), accepting Nequi, PSE, and credit/debit cards from all major banks.
